site: Example bench (GSC-02C with an OSMS20-85 stage)
notes: Example overlay only: it stands for the travel range and the mm/s range of one stage. Every bound here must be checked against the stage actually attached before use.

start_speed_mm_s.reason: example: this stage tolerates 0.001 to 2 mm/s at the start of a move

max_speed_mm_s.reason: example: this stage tolerates 0.001 to 5 mm/s

position_mm.reason: example: the documented travel of the OSMS20-85 configuration is 0 to 85 mm

distance_mm.reason: example: a relative move must still end inside 0 to 85 mm on this stage

pulses.reason: example: at 1 um per pulse the documented 0 to 85 mm range is 0 to 85000 pulses
example: a relative move must still end inside 0 to 85000 pulses on this stage
